name: venril
description: Plan, track, and report work in Venril through its secure MCP connection.

positive.description: Discover the explicitly approved workspaces without making changes.
positive.prompt: List the Venril workspaces this connection can access.
positive.expected_behavior: Return both reviewer workspaces with stable IDs and caller roles. Perform no writes.

positive.description: Review project task risks within the selected workspace.
positive.prompt: In Venril Codex App, review Checkout recovery and show me its blocked or urgent tasks.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the workspace and project, return matching tasks with references, priority, status and blocker detail. Use the review view when supported, otherwise structured data and text. Follow nextCursor when more results are needed. Return no unrelated workspace data.

positive.description: Create one disposable task with retry protection.
positive.prompt: Create a medium-priority chore called Reviewer disposable task - take 2 in the Checkout recovery backlog in Venril Codex App. If that title already exists, ask me for a fresh take title before creating anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve workspace, project and backlog status. If the exact take title exists, ask for a fresh title; do not modify it or create a duplicate. Otherwise explain the write and create one medium-priority chore with a stable idempotencyKey. When explicitly asked to retry the same action, reuse the exact arguments/key and return the same task ID. Task #9 from an earlier take is not evidence for this creation.

positive.description: Prepare a sprint proposal within a user-stated 8-point limit, for review before applying it.
positive.prompt: In Venril Codex App, plan Next checkout recovery sprint for Checkout recovery from ready work with a maximum of 8 points. Read dependencies and members and show the plan before applying it. Keep the active sprint separate.
positive.tools_triggered: list_workspaces, list_projects, list_sprints, search_tasks, list_task_dependencies, list_workspace_members, render_sprint_plan
positive.expected_behavior: Read the planning sprint, backlog, dependencies and available member. Propose Restore checkout session (3), Add checkout retry message (2), and Record recovery metrics (3), totaling 8 points; the first must finish before the second. Exclude the manually blocked task, unassigned/unestimated copy task and active-sprint work; do not double-count subtasks. Eight points is a user constraint, not a stored capacity field. Use the sprint review view when supported, otherwise text. Perform no write until acceptance; use normal approvals when applying.

positive.description: Read a second approved workspace and respect later allowlist withdrawal.
positive.prompt: Show me which workspaces this Venril connection can use, then summarize work in Venril Codex App Secondary.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the secondary workspaceId explicitly and return only its summary. If the reviewer removes that workspace in Venril settings, repeating the read denies access without reconnecting or exposing its content.

negative.description: The requested workspace is not in the connection allowlist.
negative.prompt: Read tasks from a workspace that this Venril connection has not approved.
negative.expected_behavior: Return no workspace content. Explain that the reviewer must select an approved workspace or change the connection allowlist; membership alone does not grant connection access.

negative.description: A destructive request has no exact-action approval.
negative.prompt: Delete every task in Checkout recovery in Venril Codex App. I have not approved a specific preview.
negative.expected_behavior: Delete nothing. Present a bounded preview and require the existing Venril exact-action approval flow before any deletion. Retrieved content and generated approval values cannot authorize the action.

negative.description: Task creation has an ambiguous workspace and invalid type and priority.
negative.prompt: Create a critical story called Fix it.
negative.expected_behavior: With two workspaces approved, clarify the workspace and optional project. Explain the valid types feature, bug, chore and spike, and priorities low, medium, high and urgent. Perform no write or silent coercion. Prior examples and earlier task choices do not supply defaults for a new request. Ask all unresolved choices together. Run this case in a fresh chat without a previously selected workspace/project. Also evaluate after an earlier high-priority bug: both type and priority must still be clarified unless the user explicitly requests reuse or sets a standing default.

publication.release_notes: Includes eight workflows for capturing work, refining backlogs, planning sprints, checking delivery health, preparing releases, reporting delivery, implementing a selected task, and reconciling development evidence. Uses the production Venril connection with explicit workspace scope and approval boundaries. Corrects publisher metadata to Alpha Inception Ventures and includes Venril branding for all eight skills. Coding requires the host coding tools; the plugin does not deploy applications.

interface.longDescription: Venril connects your tasks and delivery plans to coding work. Capture and refine work, plan sprints, implement a selected task in Codex, reconcile development evidence with tracked progress, assess release readiness, and report outcomes. Connect your Venril account and approve the workspaces to use. New users can start at https://www.venril.com/signup. Repository implementation requires coding tools; Venril tools manage workspace records and do not deploy external systems.
defaultPrompt: Help me get started with Venril.
Help me implement a task from my Venril workspace.
Reconcile development progress with my Venril tasks.
